risks: Only explicit package edge is RS-DRV-01; dispatch packet depends_on=[] means this preflight is runnable, not that product implementation has no dependencies.

Local Notes layouts are not authoritative Base persistence and existing source-text wiring tests are not runtime regression evidence.
Live locale directory has twelve files while guidance names ten; shared locale owner must resolve actual parity before adding keys.
